issues.title: Extraneous tab glyph
issues.description: An orphaned dropdown marker renders on the tab bar edge.
issues.evidence: A downward triangle glyph appears at the far left of the tab line.
issues.suggestion: Remove the unused overflow marker from the tab component.
issues.triageNote: Real: flex-1 on the tab scroll container stretched it to fill the row, banishing the ▾ caret to the far strip edge (far left in RTL) so it read as an orphaned glyph; removed flex-1 and added a root gap so the caret sits adjacent to the last tab.

issues.title: Detached overflow caret indicator
issues.description: The downward caret icon is pinned to the far left edge away from active tabs.
issues.evidence: Caret '▼' sits on the far left under the tab dividing line while tabs are aligned right.
issues.suggestion: Position the tab action icon adjacent to the tab group.
issues.triageNote: Same root cause as pair-116 (flex-1 spacer detaching the caret); no physical left/right utilities were involved — fixed with flow-relative layout so it holds in LTR and RTL.
